purpose.zh: 练胸，让两条胳膊往中间合更有劲
purpose.en: Builds your chest so bringing your arms together gets stronger.

text.zh: 手肘微微弯着别动，像抱大树一样打开再合拢
text.en: Soft elbows that stay put. Open wide, then hug a big tree

text.zh: 仰面躺好，膝盖弯着脚踩地，哑铃从胸口正上方开始。
text.en: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, dumbbells over your chest.

text.zh: 大臂轻轻碰到地就停，别砸地弹起来。
text.en: Stop when your upper arms touch the floor. Don't bounce off it.

commonErrors.zh: 手肘一弯一伸，变成了推
commonErrors.en: Bending and straightening your elbows so it turns into a press.

commonErrors.zh: 胳膊砸到地上再弹起来
commonErrors.en: Bouncing your arms off the floor.

cautions.zh: 先用轻哑铃，打开时胸口前面扯着疼就合小点
cautions.en: Start light. If your chest feels a tearing pull, open less.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前面夹着疼就打开少一点
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, don't open as wide.
